curation.notes: Custom dual-trap optical tweezers force-ramp (~300 nm/s) unfolding of the Zika virus exoribonuclease-resistant RNA (xrRNA1), wild type and tertiary-contact/pseudoknot mutants, held between RNA:DNA hybrid handles; mechanical resistance compared with Xrn1 resistance in gel assays and all-atom MD with force-distribution analysis. Auto record mislabelled this as AFM.

evidence.snippet: Data were sampled at 20 kHz and filtered online at the Nyquist frequency with an eight-pole Bessel filter.

filter_frequency.note: Nyquist frequency of 20 kHz sampling = 10 kHz

evidence.snippet: Data were sampled at 20 kHz and filtered online at the Nyquist frequency with an eight-pole Bessel filter.

Trap stiffnesses (0.43 and 0.46 pN/nm) were calibrated by standard methods (42). The forces for overstretching [~60 to 65 pN (43, 44)] and P4 unfolding [20 pN (35)] were used as independent reference points

bead_size.note: 600 nm avidin DN beads and 820 nm anti-digoxigenin beads

evidence.snippet: polystyrene beads (600 and 820 nm in diameter, coated respectively with avidin DN and anti-digoxigenin) to create dumbbells
Force-ramp measurements were performed by moving the traps holding the beads apart at a constant speed of ~300 nm/s

handle_sequences.annotations: a 2107-bp-long handle sequence ... labeled with digoxigenin (5′ handle)
a second, 840-bp-long handle sequence ... labeled with ... biotin (3′ handle)

entities.name: Zika virus xrRNA1 (wild type and tertiary-contact / pseudoknot mutants)
mutations: site-directed mutants disrupting tertiary contacts of the threaded 5′ end
single and double pseudoknot base-pair disruptions

evidence.snippet: Here, we have determined which interactions are most important for generating mechanical rigidity in the Zika virus xrRNA, by systematically mutating tertiary contacts.

entities.name: RNA:DNA hybrid handles (2107 bp digoxigenin, 840 bp biotin)

evidence.snippet: RNA transcripts were thermally annealed to two single-stranded (ss) DNA sequences complementary to each handle in the RNA transcript; the latter were produced by asymmetric PCR and labeled with digoxigenin (5′ handle) or biotin (3′ handle).
